mission.objective: Two independent nodes that both need to touch the same shared file
mission.title: Two features, one shared config file
mission.task: Add feature-flag support for the new checkout flow and, separately, add feature-flag support for the new onboarding flow. Neither depends on the other's code, but both need to register their flag in the same src/shared.ts flag table.

candidateNodes.title: Checkout flag
candidateNodes.task: Register and read the checkout feature flag, wiring it into the checkout flow.
acceptance: the checkout flag gates the new flow correctly

candidateNodes.title: Onboarding flag
candidateNodes.task: Register and read the onboarding feature flag, wiring it into the onboarding flow.
acceptance: the onboarding flag gates the new flow correctly
